title: spec: VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY suggests count_distinct, which a list-view column summary cannot take (#32449 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gENvvRYHmL5nFTF5x

Filing gate: ② measured gap, reported by the #32449 card thread in PR #32502 (os-dev-report 6812271120, out_of_scope_findings 3). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:spec`, `packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts:274` (`VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY`) and the members that print it.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY` → 1 hit (#32449 itself).
reach: an author who puts a summary over a formula (virtual) field on a list-view column. After PR #32502 the refusal prints this one remedy sentence, which ends "`count` / `count_distinct` answer a different question". `count_distinct` is not a `ColumnSummary` member (the list-view summary takes `count_unique`), so the hint names a value the author cannot write there. The dataset compile leg (`service-analytics`) and the grid surface print the same sentence, and `count_distinct` is correct there.

## Ask

Make the remedy name a value each surface accepts. Two options: one surface-neutral sentence, or a per-surface variant chosen by the caller. Keep the 200-character bound and the single source; `os explain` holds the sentence verbatim. Pin the list-view wording. No accept-set change: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: unchanged`.
